_readme: Per-finish QR gate. on = the builder offers the QR toggle and the laser may engrave it. test = test-gated, stays OFF until a test tag decodes first try on 3 phones (a current iPhone, an iPhone 4+ years old, a mid-range Android) at 10-30 cm, indoors and in daylight. off = never. Flip a value after the laser test matrix, commit, deploy. Unknown keys are ignored. The laser also needs a TUNED qr-* preset before it will auto-generate (laser/presets).
